description: Closure of left multiplication on the Jones normal forms, indexed by (I,J). The δ rule is COMPLETE and holds on all 3456 products at n=2..7: loops=1 iff (I',J')=(I,J) iff k in I and k-1 not in I -- a condition on I alone. The (I',J') formula for the loops=0 branch is NOT identified and is recorded as open.
arithmetic: exact integers, sets and tuples; no floating point
scope: checked at n <= 7, not proved at general n; the δ rule has a proof sketch (e_k commutes past a block iff its top is <= k-2, then e_k^2 = δ e_k) and is ready to formalise. Wires to nothing.

rules.rule: loops=1 <=> k in I and k-1 not in I
loops=1 <=> k in I and k+1 not in I
loops=1 <=> k in I and k not in J

checks.note: the δ appears exactly at the fixed points, and the test is on I alone -- J does not enter it
recorded as open. The |I'| decrease is what makes word length non-monotone, so an insertion-shaped rule cannot be right.
